decision: Owner decision 2026-09-24 (ADR-028 section 5): these 10 ADR-023 deployment-verification evidence copies inside the campaign-014 source snapshot stay tracked, because the campaign's plan.json, offline-gates.json and seed-audit.json pin each file by path and SHA-256 and their content scan is clean. Only these exact paths with these exact digests are excepted from the tracked deploy/state rule; any changed byte, rename or additional file fails. Purging them with a history rewrite remains an owner option.
